_note: ZAP alerts reviewed and accepted, with the reason. scripts/zap-gate.mjs fails the build on any High alert and on any Medium alert not listed here. Review this list when the app changes.
10055: CSP style-src 'unsafe-inline': the prerendered public pages carry React style attributes, and Motion animates inline styles. script-src stays 'self' (no inline script), which is what protects against XSS. Reviewed 2026-11-12.
10099: 'Source Code Disclosure - SQL' is the deliberate policy snippet shown in the landing page's Trust section (src/components/landing/Trust.tsx), not leaked source. Reviewed 2026-11-12.
90004: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp would block avatars served from Supabase Storage and GitHub. The app does not use SharedArrayBuffer, which is what COEP protects. Reviewed 2026-11-12.
10036: The 'Server' header on /supabase/ comes from the local Supabase gateway behind the proxy in CI; production answers from Supabase's own edge. Reviewed 2026-11-12.
10098: Cross-Domain Misconfiguration on /auth/v1/* is Supabase Auth's own wildcard CORS (the local stack's gateway in CI; production Supabase does the same). Sessions are sent as bearer tokens in headers, never as cookies, so another origin cannot act with a visitor's login. Our own pages and /api set no CORS headers. Reviewed 2026-11-12.
40040: CORS Misconfiguration on /supabase/auth/v1/* is the same wildcard Access-Control-Allow-Origin as 10098, passed through the same-origin proxy from Supabase Auth. Sessions are bearer tokens sent in headers and bodies, never cookies, so a foreign origin gains nothing it could not get by calling Supabase directly. Our pages and /api send no CORS headers. Reviewed 2026-11-14.
